subject: Weird Shiny Server Issue vs. Local Rstudio

messages.author: 5c6455b85862fd52
messages.subject: Weird Shiny Server Issue vs. Local Rstudio
parts:
Hi,

I've run into this a few times now where I select reactively on DT tables on my local machine, which then does something like generate a sub-table, for example.
When I move the code over to my local server with Shiny install, I cannot seem to get this version to parse the table clicks.

When I run this sanity check below, nothing echoes back on my server, but it works finally locally and when I deploy it on shinyapps.io.
I read somewhere that this might be a 32/64 issue.

Any ideas?

Regards,

Nick

===== server callbacks


select.inventory <- reactive ({
# finds out what row in highlighted in inventory.table

  input$inventory.table_rows_selected
})


output$inventory_row_check = renderPrint({
# confirms the highlight in the UI using verbatimText

  s = input$inventory.table_rows_selected
  if (length(s)) {
    temp = paste("row:",s,wood.data[s,2])
    print(temp)}
})
